title: CWF: A Collaborative Writing Framework for Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing
abstract: arXiv:2609.06126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing, a novel task that requires adapting scientific explanations to audiences with different cognitive levels while preserving factual accuracy. However, improving personalization often introduces simplifications that increase the risk of hallucination and factual distortion. To address these challenges, we first construct a dataset of 39,134 entries and a reader-centric Personalized Science Communication Benchmark (PSCB) that jointly evaluates audience adaptation and factual accuracy. To reduce data and computational requirements while improving generalization across domains and audiences, we introduce DA-MoE, which explicitly decouples audience adaptation from domain knowledge through separate modeling. translated_title: CWF：一个面向个性化且可靠科普写作的协同写作框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“个性化且可靠的科普写作”这一新任务，该任务要求在保持事实准确性的同时，将科学解释调整以适应不同认知水平的受众。然而，提升个性化程度往往会引入简化处理，从而增加幻觉和事实扭曲的风险。为应对这些挑战，我们首先构建了一个包含39,134条数据的数据集，以及一个以读者为中心的个性化科学传播基准（PSCB），该基准可联合评估受众适应性和事实准确性。为了在降低数据和计算需求的同时提升跨领域、跨受众的泛化能力，我们提出了DA-MoE，它通过分离建模显式地将受众适应与领域知识解耦。为了在证据稀缺的场景下实现稳健的验证与修订，我们提出了一种多智能体事实核查机制，该机制通过角色特定的智能体辩论来增强有限的证据。
tldr: 该论文提出CWF协同写作框架，通过构建个性化科学传播基准PSCB、将受众适应与领域知识解耦的DA-MoE模型，以及多智能体辩论事实核查机制，实现了面向不同认知水平受众的个性化且事实准确的科普写作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CWF, a collaborative writing framework that enables personalized and factually reliable popular science writing by introducing a Personalized Science Communication Benchmark (PSCB), a DA-MoE model that decouples audience adaptation from domain knowledge, and a multi-agent debate-based fact-checking mechanism.
